id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a0e4: "Thanks to you I could return to my beautiful home. Thank you so much.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a290: "Tales of your battle defeating the Dark One have reached the undersea kingdom too! You're so strong~!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a47c: "But lately the Queen's face has been clouded. She seems to be worried about something.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a630: "...The Queen asked you to defeat the monster ravaging the sea, right? We're all counting on you... do your best.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a8ec: "No gills! No fins! No webbing! You're definitely a human!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a950: "The human I've longed for since childhood is right before my eyes now!! I'm so glad... I lived!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|aa7c: "Welcome to the National Museum! We display rare things humans dropped in twenty thousand years of history!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ab64: "Look! The spear of the sea god Poseidon! A human threw it in eight hundred years ago, and it's still stuck in the rock!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ac54: "Look! The spear of the sea god Poseidon! This unnaturally sharp tip...! Sharper than a great white's tooth!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ad30: "To make such a terrifying thing, humans must be creatures of unbelievable power!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ae50: "This is the Nautica National Museum. We display slightly rare things humans dropped.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|af00: "I studied this seventy years as the spear of Poseidon, but after leaving the kingdom I learned the truth.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b000: "It's a light from the human world, it seems. Like our deep-sea anglerfish. Sigh... What a shock... Despair...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b1e8: "Human traveler, listen. Gods of humans and gods of the sea differ in form, but the heart of prayer is what matters. Now then...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b338: "Oh! Recovering from those wounds, you're a very lucky fish. All thanks to your daily devotion.

id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bb1c: "A fish who forgives someone like me, how big-hearted! I'm happy to have such a wonderful neighbor!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bcf8: "Humans are scary, but compared to what my brother did, it's like the moon and a turtle.

id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c1f8: "A neighbor is a friend, a teacher, and sometimes food. Chased by Jarvis from the seabed, I finally understood this saying.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c2fc: "If you're hungry, one bite is forgiven! Let's get along, neighbors! ...That's the idea, right? Ha ha ha~!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c460: "Is it the sound of ripples or seagulls' wings~♪ Sleep, sleep, children of the sea, to my song echoing over the waves~♪
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c530: "The child of light awakens~♪ Calms the roaring sea~♪ Until bright tomorrow comes~♪

id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c704: "I'm not slacking. I'm saving my strength for the time that's coming. This is proper work too.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c7fc: "...What's the time that's coming? I can't say it myself. Ask the Queen~.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c8f4: "Jarvis chased me around and I'm worn out...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c950: "If I hadn't saved my strength for this moment, I'd surely have been sea dust. Resting is important sometimes~.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ca74: "Ahh, lazing around a peaceful world with no guilt is the best~. It's all thanks to you. Thanks~.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cc5c: "H-human! What are you doing on the seabed?!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ccc0: "We sea folk don't taste good, and eating mermaids won't make you immortal!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cef8: "We sea folk don't taste good, and eating mermaids won't make you immortal!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cd74: "...What? You're looking for an orb sunk on the seabed? I don't know! Ask the mermaid Queen about hard stuff!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d014: "Traveler, are your wounds okay now? You were a mess, tangled in the coral forest.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d0c0: "From every angle you looked dead, so the sharks were discussing how to cook you.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d160: "If the Queen hadn't stopped them, you'd be in a shark's belly now, never to wake again.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d284: "The Luminary's human form is cool, but isn't it inconvenient in the undersea kingdom?

id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d320: "Ask the Queen in the throne room and she'll probably give you a more mobile form, so go see her.

id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d51c: "No fish in this sea will try to eat you now. You're truly the Luminary of hope.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d850: "You, once a battered little fish, finally beat the Dark One! Fish truly aren't what they seem!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d960: "Lately violent monsters throw their weight around the sea, a worry for the Queen.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|da70: "Everyone's saying you're going to hunt Death Aegir? You're brave... I respect you.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|db4c: "Maybe because Death Aegir was defeated, the sea feels calmer. I can even take a leisurely stroll.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dcb4: "I'm the deep-sea judge. From small disputes in the sea to crimes of the century, I judge them all.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dda0: "Today's trial is an assault case over whether someone ate a friend's flank. It looks like a difficult trial.

id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f8f8: "Hey. If you came to my shop, you're a cut above the peaceful white fish of this town, right?
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fe14: "Only our tavern serves Nautica's specialty, tear wine!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fe88: "Tear wine is made of mermaid tears, a single pearl, and foam-sea water. One sip opens a world of dreams!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ff80: "Splash wine in the water and drink it like a shower together, that's the cool seabed way! Ha ha ha~!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1007: "Nautica's specialty, tear wine, is made of mermaid tears, a single pearl, and foam-sea water.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1013: "Countless mermaid tears were shed over the kingdom's collapse. It may be a bit too salty to call tear wine...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1030: "This is an extremely dangerous item from the human world. It's dangerous, so traveler fish, best not get close.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|103c: "After all, they stuff fish and seaweed in it and put it over fire!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1046: "It must have been used for the cruelest punishment for criminals, I mean criminal fish: boiled fish.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1059: "The most interesting human item I've seen is a white stone called soap.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1066: "Within half a day of discovery it turned to bubbles and vanished. A truly mystical experience.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|107b: "I know... I know. Eating bait on a hook means the other world, my dad and mom said.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1087: "...But this lovely smell. Just a taste might be okay...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|109c: "This building is the Nautica National Museum. Clever fish gather here to study humans.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10cb: "This building is the Nautica National Museum. Clever fish gather here to study humans.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10a9: "The items displayed there are rare things humans dropped. They're Nautica's precious national treasures.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10d8: "The items displayed there are rare things humans dropped. They're Nautica's precious national treasures.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10b5: "Some are dangerous enough to kill you just by touching, so be careful when you visit.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10e5: "Some are dangerous enough to kill you just by touching, so be careful when you visit.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10fe: "Our ancestors, we undersea folk, made a promise with Yggdrasil in exchange for safe lives on the seabed...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|110c: "Someday the child of light will visit the seabed. Then protect and help the child from the evil darkness closing in...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|111b: "When I saw you fall into the sea, I nearly forgot to breathe through my gills. I thought the child of light had come.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|112e: "I hear that since the black sun appeared, monsters have grown violent one after another and the surface is getting worse.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|113d: "If the surface is that ravaged, honestly I'm terribly anxious about how long this undersea kingdom will stay safe...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1156: "That's it, you. I was looking for you. You're the ex-human fish everyone talks about? I'm the president of Nautica Lantern Corp.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1163: "We shine brightly to light the kingdom. Interested in a streetlight job?
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11aa: "We shine brightly to light the kingdom. Interested in a streetlight job?
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1174: "...Wait, looking closely, you don't glow anywhere.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|117a: "When you fell to the seabed, your mark flashed, I thought. Maybe I imagined it.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|118a: "Sadly, if you want to be a streetlight you'd have to be reborn as a fish with a glowing antenna.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11c7: "Sadly, if you want to be a streetlight you'd have to be reborn as a fish with a glowing antenna.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|119d: "That's it, you. I called you. You're the ex-human fish everyone talks about? I'm the president of Nautica Lantern Corp.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11b8: "...Wait, looking closely, you don't glow anywhere. Then you can't do the streetlight job.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11de: "We light the seabed: Nautica Lantern Corp!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1203: "We light the seabed: Nautica Lantern Corp!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11e6: "I light the seabed: I'm with Nautica Lantern Corp!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11ee: "The lights we shine are fully self-generated clean energy! Gentle on the eyes, our streetlights!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|120a: "The lights we shine are fully self-generated clean energy! Gentle on the eyes, our streetlights!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1223: "Maybe I'll quit my job~. That's what I'm thinking~.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|122a: "However hard I work every day, no one in my family thanks me~. I can't keep doing this~.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|123a: "I hated the streetlight job, but now that everyone's in a dark mood, it's a bit different.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1247: "Even our tiny lights might become someone's hope. With that thought I'll work hard.

id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12c6: "I lost my temper over the sudden nibble on my flank and filed a suit, but this gloominess ends now!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12d1: "More importantly, let's celebrate, neighbors, that we got back to our home! Right, brother!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12e6: "Creatures of land and sea alike return to Yggdrasil someday. Only sooner or later.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12f4: "When that time comes, I'll see the real Yggdrasil for the first time in my life. I'm looking forward to it~.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|130a: "I heard the Luminary was born on land, so I figured you'd be human-shaped, but a fish, who'd have thought...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|131c: "That purple body and smooth forehead! A handsome one! I'd like you as my grandchild's husband!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1326: "Of course she's an anglerfish like me! Her light is famous as the most beautiful on the seabed~!
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1337: "No human in the world would think the Luminary who saved the world has a fishy side~.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1345: "As a fellow fish, I respect you~.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1357: "The seabed stays beautiful and peaceful because the Queen protects us.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1362: "The undersea kingdom's ceiling has an invisible barrier by the Queen's magic, so evil monsters can't enter.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1373: "As long as she's here, the kingdom's prosperity will never end. I'm so glad I was born on the seabed.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1389: "After Jarvis drove us out, my husband vanished into the southern sea to protect me.
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1393: "Now I envy humans. On the seabed even tears of sorrow vanish in the waves...
id./param/region/r019.pack|npc_ie.bxon|139f: "Like human tears, I want to hold this sorrow in my chest and keep shedding tears for him...

tm.「今 地上では 大変なことが起きているそうね。\n 地上が どんな様子か知りたけ: "I hear terrible things are happening on the surface. If you want to know how it is, ask Queen Seren directly.
tm.「女王さまは 王国の いちばん北にある\n 海底宮殿の玉座の間に いらっしゃるは: "The Queen should be in the throne room of the undersea palace at the kingdom's far north.
tm.「ここは 海底王国ムウレア。\n うるわしき 人魚の女王が治める\n 青き 海底: "This is the undersea kingdom Nautica. A blue paradise under the sea ruled by a beautiful mermaid queen.
tm.「あなたのおかげで 美しい故郷に\n 帰ってくることができたわ。\n 本当に あ: "Thanks to you I could return to my beautiful home. Thank you so much.
tm.「勇者さまが 魔王を倒した戦いのお話は\n 海底王国にも 届いているわ！\n あ: "Tales of your battle defeating the Dark One have reached the undersea kingdom too! You're so strong~!
tm.「でも 最近の女王さまは\n お顔を くもらせがちで……。\n 何か お悩みが: "But lately the Queen's face has been clouded. She seems to be worried about something.
tm.「……女王さまから 海を荒らす魔物を\n 退治してほしいって 頼まれたんでしょ？: "...The Queen asked you to defeat the monster ravaging the sea, right? We're all counting on you... do your best.
tm.「エラなし！ ヒレなし！ 水かきなし！\n まさしく そなたは人間だ！: "No gills! No fins! No webbing! You're definitely a human!
tm.「幼き頃より あこがれ続けた\n 人間が 今っ 私の目の前に！！\n 生きてて…: "The human I've longed for since childhood is right before my eyes now!! I'm so glad... I lived!
tm.「ここは ムウレア国立博物館！\n 海底２万年の歴史でも たいへん めずらしい\: "Welcome to the National Museum! We display rare things humans dropped in twenty thousand years of history!
tm.「見てください！ この海神ポセイドンのヤリを！\n 人間が 海底に投げ込んで ８: "Look! The spear of the sea god Poseidon! A human threw it in eight hundred years ago, and it's still stuck in the rock!
tm.「見てください！ この海神ポセイドンのヤリを！\n 異様に研ぎすまされた この切: "Look! The spear of the sea god Poseidon! This unnaturally sharp tip...! Sharper than a great white's tooth!
tm.「こんな おそろしい品を作るなんて\n 人間とは 信じられないチカラを持った\n: "To make such a terrifying thing, humans must be creatures of unbelievable power!
tm.「ここは ムウレア国立博物館。\n ちょっとだけ めずらしい\n 人間の落とし物: "This is the Nautica National Museum. We display slightly rare things humans dropped.
tm.「私はね。これを海神ポセイドンのヤリと思い\n ７０年間 研究してまいりましたが: "I studied this seventy years as the spear of Poseidon, but after leaving the kingdom I learned the truth.
tm.「これは 人間の世界の明かりだそうですね。\n 海底でいう チョウチンアンコウな: "It's a light from the human world, it seems. Like our deep-sea anglerfish. Sigh... What a shock... Despair...
tm.「人間の旅人さん よいですか？\n 人の神と 海の神……カタチは違えど\n 祈る: "Human traveler, listen. Gods of humans and gods of the sea differ in form, but the heart of prayer is what matters. Now then...
tm.「おお！ あのケガから 息を吹き返すとは\n アナタは とても幸運な お魚だ。\: "Oh! Recovering from those wounds, you're a very lucky fish. All thanks to your daily devotion.
tm.「人の神と 海の神……カタチは違えど\n 祈る気持ちが 大切なのです。\n さぁ: "Gods of humans and gods of the sea differ in form, but the heart of prayer is what matters. Now then...
tm.「人の神と 海の神……カタチは違えど\n 信じる者を 神は お救いくださる。\n: "Gods of humans and gods of the sea differ in form, but gods save those who believe. Now then...
tm.「見た目など 関係ありません。\n 人の神と 海の神……カタチは違えど\n 祈る: "Appearance doesn't matter. Human and sea gods differ in form, but the heart of prayer is what matters. Now then...
tm.「あれは 数か月前のことになります。\n ２週間ほど ワカメしか食べてなくって\: "It was a few months ago. I'd eaten only seaweed for two weeks and was starving when he swam by.
tm.「もう おいしそうで おいしそうで\n 気がついたら 彼の右わき腹を\n ちょこ: "He looked so delicious that, before I knew it, I'd taken a little nibble of his right flank.
tm.「せめて ひと声かけてから\n 彼をかじるべきでしたよね……。: "I should have at least called out before biting him...
tm.「ほんの出来心だったとはいえ\n 魚のわき腹を 無断でかじるなんて\n とても: "Even on impulse, biting a fish's flank without permission is unforgivable...
tm.「そんな私を許してくださる お魚さんは\n なんて 心が広いんでしょうか！\n: "A fish who forgives someone like me, how big-hearted! I'm happy to have such a wonderful neighbor!
tm.「人間は おそろしいが\n オレの弟が しでかしたことに くらべれば\n 月と: "Humans are scary, but compared to what my brother did, it's like the moon and a turtle.
tm.「おっといけねぇな。\n 初対面の相手に しゃべりすぎたぜ。: "Oops, I talked too much to someone I just met.
tm.「忘れてくんな 人間さんよ。\n 魚には 魚の悩みってのがあるのさ。\n 人間の: "Forget it, human. Fish have fish worries. I can't tell a human like you.
tm.「すまんな 人間さんよ。\n 魚には 魚の悩みってのがあるのさ。\n 人間のアン: "Sorry, human. Fish have fish worries. I can't tell a human like you.
tm.「今やってる裁判の被告人は オレの弟なんだ。\n 魚に ことわりもなく わき腹を: "The defendant in this trial is my brother. Biting a fish's flank without asking, what a terrible thing, even for my brother.
tm.「しかし 魚を食べるのは 当たり前のこと\n 裁判長さんの お裁きが\n お優し: "Still, eating fish is natural. I just pray the judge's ruling is kind...
tm.「隣人は友であり 師であり 時に食料である。\n ジャコラに追われ 海底を離れて: "A neighbor is a friend, a teacher, and sometimes food. Chased by Jarvis from the seabed, I finally understood this saying.
tm.「腹がへったら ひとくちならば 許してやろう！\n 隣人同士 仲良く やろうぜ！: "If you're hungry, one bite is forgiven! Let's get along, neighbors! ...That's the idea, right? Ha ha ha~!
tm.「さざ波の音か カモメの羽音か～♪\n 波間に ひびく わたしの唄声で\n 眠れ: "Is it the sound of ripples or seagulls' wings~♪ Sleep, sleep, children of the sea, to my song echoing over the waves~♪
tm.「光の御子が 目を覚まし～♪\n 海鳴りを しずめて\n 光ある明日を呼ぶまで～: "The child of light awakens~♪ Calms the roaring sea~♪ Until bright tomorrow comes~♪
tm.なんだか 眠くなってきた。\n人魚の唄は 長く聴かないほうが よさそうだ。:
You feel sleepy.
It's best not to listen to the mermaid's song for long.
tm.「オレっち なまけてるんじゃねえよ。\n 来たるべき時のために 体力を温存してん: "I'm not slacking. I'm saving my strength for the time that's coming. This is proper work too.
tm.「……来たるべき時が なんなのかって？\n オレっちのクチからは 言えねえことだ: "...What's the time that's coming? I can't say it myself. Ask the Queen~.
tm.「ジャコラのヤツに 追いかけまわされて\n オレっち もう クタクタだ……。: "Jarvis chased me around and I'm worn out...
tm.「この時のために 体力を温存していなかったら\n 間違いなく 海のもくずになって: "If I hadn't saved my strength for this moment, I'd surely have been sea dust. Resting is important sometimes~.
tm.「はあ～ 平和な世界で ゴロゴロするのは\n 罪悪感がなくて 最高だな～。\n: "Ahh, lazing around a peaceful world with no guilt is the best~. It's all thanks to you. Thanks~.
tm.「に……人間さん！\n 海底に 何をしにきたんだい！？: "H-human! What are you doing on the seabed?!
tm.「オレたち海の民は 食べても おいしくないし\n 人魚を食べても 不老不死になん: "We sea folk don't taste good, and eating mermaids won't make you immortal!
tm.「……え？ 海底に沈んだオーブを探してる？\n オレ そんなの知らないよ！ むず: "...What? You're looking for an orb sunk on the seabed? I don't know! Ask the mermaid Queen about hard stuff!
tm.「旅人さん キズは もういいのかい？\n アンタときたら ボロボロの格好で\n: "Traveler, are your wounds okay now? You were a mess, tangled in the coral forest.
tm.「どっから どう見ても\n 死んじゃってるから いいだろうって\n サメたちが: "From every angle you looked dead, so the sharks were discussing how to cook you.
tm.「女王さまが 止めてくださらなかったら\n アンタは 今頃 サメの腹の中。\n: "If the Queen hadn't stopped them, you'd be in a shark's belly now, never to wake again.
tm.「勇者さまの人間姿は かっこいいけど\n 海底王国では ちょっと 不便じゃない？: "The Luminary's human form is cool, but isn't it inconvenient in the undersea kingdom?
tm.「玉座の間にいる 女王さまに お願いすれば\n もっと 動きやすい姿にしてくれる: "Ask the Queen in the throne room and she'll probably give you a more mobile form, so go see her.
tm.「ボロボロで ちっぽけな小魚だった アンタが\n セレンさまもかなわなかった あ: "I'm shocked that you, once a battered little fish, beat Jarvis, whom even Lady Seren couldn't!
tm.「もう この海で アンタを食べようとする魚は\n どこにも いないだろうね。\n: "No fish in this sea will try to eat you now. You're truly the Luminary of hope.
tm.「ボロボロで ちっぽけな小魚だった アンタが\n ついに 魔王をやっつけちゃった: "You, once a battered little fish, finally beat the Dark One! Fish truly aren't what they seem!
tm.「近頃は 凶暴化している魔物たちが\n ずいぶんと 海で 幅をきかせていてね。\: "Lately violent monsters throw their weight around the sea, a worry for the Queen.
tm.「みんなが ウワサしてるけど あんた\n デスエーギルを 退治に行くんだって？\: "Everyone's saying you're going to hunt Death Aegir? You're brave... I respect you.
tm.「デスエーギルが倒されたせいか\n すこし 海がおだやかになった気がするよ。\n: "Maybe because Death Aegir was defeated, the sea feels calmer. I can even take a leisurely stroll.
tm.「私は 深海の裁判長。\n 海の中での ちょっとした いさこざから\n 世紀の大: "I'm the deep-sea judge. From small disputes in the sea to crimes of the century, I judge them all.
tm.「今日の裁判は 友人のわき腹を\n 食べた 食べないの傷害ざた……。\n なかな: "Today's trial is an assault case over whether someone ate a friend's flank. It looks like a difficult trial.
tm.「隣人は友であり 師であり 時に食料である。\n 皆が 海底の法律を忘れなければ: "A neighbor is a friend, a teacher, and sometimes food. If all remembered the seabed's law, sad cases wouldn't happen.
tm.「私は 深海の裁判長。\n おたがいが 許しあえるなら\n もはや 私の出番はあ: "I'm the deep-sea judge. If both sides can forgive each other, I'm out of work.
tm.「なにごとも 平和が いちばん！\n 気づかずに通りすぎる 日常こそが\n 本当: "Peace is best! The everyday you pass without noticing is true happiness!
tm.「ようこそ ここは 海底王国ムウレア。\n あなた キズは だいぶ癒えたみたいだ: "Welcome to the undersea kingdom Nautica. Your wounds seem mostly healed. Good, good!
tm.「だけど あなたは お魚の姿だし\n 残念だけど 陸地には戻れないよ。\n でも: "But you're in fish form, so sadly you can't return to land. But...
tm.「目が覚めたことを 女王さまに お伝えすれば\n きっと あなたの手助けをしてく: "If you tell the Queen you've woken, she'll help you, so go to the undersea palace once.
tm.「今の あなたは お魚の姿だし\n 残念だけど 陸地には戻れないよ。\n でも…: "You're in fish form now, so sadly you can't return to land. But...
tm.「だけど あなたは お魚の姿だし\n 残念だけど 陸地には戻れないよ。ごめんね。: "But you're in fish form, so sadly you can't return to land. Sorry.
tm.「今の あなたは お魚の姿だし\n 残念だけど 陸地には戻れないよ。ごめんね。: "You're in fish form now, so sadly you can't return to land. Sorry.
tm.「女王さまは この先の 守り人の海で\n あなたを待っておいでです。\n どうぞ: "The Queen awaits you in the Sea of the Guardians ahead. Please proceed.
tm.「女王さまから その姿を授かった あなたには\n 海底王国を 自由に行き来する権: "You, who received that form from the Queen, may roam the undersea kingdom freely. Please pass through this gate.
tm.返事がない。人間の言葉は通じないようだ。: There's no response. Human words don't seem to get through.
tm.「よぉ。オレの店に来たってことは\n 平和ボケした この町の白身魚どもとは\n: "Hey. If you came to my shop, you're a cut above the peaceful white fish of this town, right?
tm.「……いいぜ 気に入った。\n アンタは いい友達になれそうだ。\n 仲良くやろ: "...I like you. You'd make a good friend. Let's get along, brother.
tm.「さて 何を買うんだ……と いきたいところだが\n 品物を届ける運送魚が 近頃: "Now, what'll you buy... I'd say, but the delivery fish haven't been coming lately. I've got nothing to sell. Come back later.
tm.「アタマから 食われたくなかったら\n 今すぐ お家に帰んな ボウヤ。: "If you don't want to be eaten head first, go home right now, kid.
tm.「……ってのは冗談だ。\n 隣人は友であり 師であり 時に食料である。\n 海底: "...Just kidding. A neighbor is a friend, a teacher, and sometimes food. Gluttony is banned by the seabed's law.
tm.「オレはサメだが 法律は守る。\n 店に来る お客は ぜったいに食わないぜ。\n: "I'm a shark, but I obey the law. I never eat customers. Relax, little fish.
tm.返事がない。人間の言葉は通じないようだ。\n人魚の女王に 魚にしてもらおう。:
No response. Human words don't get through.
Ask the mermaid Queen to make you a fish.
tm.「……いいぜ 気に入った。\n どれでも 好きなのを買ってきな。: "...I like you. Buy whatever you like.
tm.「……ってのは冗談だ。\n 素直なところが 気に入ったぜ。\n どれでも 好きな: "...Just kidding. I like your honesty. Buy whatever you like.
tm.「よぉ。オレの店に来たってことは\n 平和ボケした この町の白身魚どもとは\n: "Hey. If you came to my shop, you're a cut above the peaceful white fish of this town, right?
tm.「ムウレア名物 涙のワインを飲めるのは\n うちの酒場だけだ！: "Only our tavern serves Nautica's specialty, tear wine!
tm.「涙のワインの原料は\n 人魚の涙と ひとつぶの真珠と 泡海の水。\n ひとくち: "Tear wine is made of mermaid tears, a single pearl, and foam-sea water. One sip opens a world of dreams!
tm.「水中に ワインをぶちまけて\n みんなで 浴びるように飲むのが\n クールな海: "Splash wine in the water and drink it like a shower together, that's the cool seabed way! Ha ha ha~!
